ChipKind.description: One chip kind a card can carry. The set is closed: a card renders only chips this enum names, so a new chip kind cannot reach the board without a schema change (DR-BP-07, DR-BP-16).

oneOf.description: The Ticket's priority (DR-LC-12). Every card carries it.
The kind-scoped progress: Acceptance Criteria progress for Implementations and Bugs, completion progress for Tasks. Every card carries it.
The Spec the Ticket attaches to; optional for a Bug.
The effective implementer of an Implementation, named by its Execution Profile.
The reviewers of an Implementation; more than two collapse to `+N` on the card (DR-BP-14).
The Lane holding the Ticket's active execution (DR-LW-01).
What holds the Ticket back: registered dependencies and explicit external blockers.
Where the Bug report came from: its reporter evidence.
The execution profiles a Bug runs under: planned before dispatch, effective with a fallback indicator during execution (DR-BP-12, DR-BP-13).
The Task's subtype of the closed set (DR-TK-08).
The Task's schedule or due date.
Who executes a Task: the operator, or the named profile.

TicketKind.description: The closed Ticket kind vocabulary on the wire (DR-TK-01).

oneOf.description: A small vertical product slice of exactly one Spec.
A record of incorrect behaviour, with qualification evidence.
Bounded operational, investigative, or administrative work.

description: The chip set one kind of card carries, in the order the card renders it.

chips.description: Every chip a card of this kind carries, in render order.

kind.description: The Ticket kind this chip set belongs to.
